release_notes:
Publish Now for discovered services, longer admin sessions, supplier description on discovery

New Services (Pending Review) gets a "Publish Now" action for any eligible
(category-mapped) draft, plus a bulk "Publish Now Selected" alongside bulk
delete -- publishes immediately instead of waiting for the next eligible
cron run. Eligibility now also catches a draft whose category was deleted
after it was staged, which previously still counted as mapped.

Auto-discovered services now carry a supplier-provided description (when
sent) straight into the draft's "Detail:" field instead of arriving blank.

Admin and customer login sessions now last 24 hours of inactivity instead
of PHP's 24-minute default.
